details.description: bge-base-en-v1.5 is a base-scale English text embedding model from BAAI's (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence) BGE (BAAI General Embedding) series, built on a BERT architecture and offered on Together AI. It maps English text into 768-dimensional dense vectors for semantic similarity and retrieval, and version 1.5 improves the similarity-score distribution over earlier BGE releases without requiring an instruction prefix on the sentence-similarity task. It accepts inputs up to 512 tokens and is released under the MIT license.
advantages: Scores 63.55 average across 56 tasks on the MTEB English benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 53.25 on MTEB Retrieval and 82.4 on MTEB STS (semantic textual similarity), per its Hugging Face model card.
Released under the permissive MIT license, per its Hugging Face model card.
Downloaded over 10 million times on Hugging Face, indicating wide production use.
disadvantages: Maximum input length of 512 tokens, short relative to newer long-context embedding models.
English only; BAAI publishes separate Chinese (bge-base-zh-v1.5) and multilingual (bge-m3) models for other languages, per its Hugging Face model card.
use_cases: Passage retrieval for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
Document and passage embedding for search

notes: Catalog facts (max_input_tokens 512, text_input/text_output modality) match the model's 512-token max sequence length and its role as a text-only embedding model. The Hugging Face card recommends adding the instruction 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:' to queries only (not passages) for retrieval use, which is an implementation detail rather than a strength/weakness so was left out of advantages/disadvantages.
